summary: Module 5 CONTEXT: Refine vs Restart -- the two-iteration rule and the sunk cost trap. MICRO-EXERCISE resolved: Output A (70% correct, DB-trigger event system, raw rows, no team/permission filtering) = RESTART -- the database-coupling is structural; 'fixing' it means ripping out the delivery mechanism, and doing it inside the polluted conversation is a rewrite pretending to be an iteration. Output B (40% correct, proper pub/sub with typed payloads + team channels, but stubs and incomplete WebSocket) = ITERATE -- stubs, connection bugs, missing reconnection are all surface; each fix is independent and does not break the event bus. The test that decides: 'if you fix this issue, does the rest of the output stay valid?' Surface = yes; structural = fixing it requires rethinking other parts. Applied the same test to my own M2-M4 work: (1) the M2 Task 2 schema conflict (owner_id vs created_by, flat vs join table) was STRUCTURAL -- the right call was rewriting the prompt with the interface contract, not patching the agent's silent adaptation; (2) the M3 errors.py redact bug was SURFACE at the code level (one regex change, everything else valid) -- iterate, which I did in one edit; (3) the M4 IDOR gap was a MISSING constraint, fixed by adding it to the build prompt (a restart of the invitation task with a better prompt, applying 'what I learned' -- the module's exact prescription). Internalized: two iterations is the threshold because of context pollution -- after two targeted corrections, accumulated conversation (original prompt + 2 outputs + 2 corrections) forces the agent to satisfy conflicting instructions; non-convergence at iteration 2 means the foundation is wrong, and the fix is a FRESH prompt with a different approach, using the failure to write better constraints.
evidence: Micro-exercise: Output A = restart (structural DB coupling), Output B = iterate (surface stubs)
M2 schema conflict classified structural -> prompt rewrite with interface contract
M3 redact bug classified surface -> single-edit iterate
M4 IDOR classified missing-constraint -> fresh prompt with guard embedded
